about: How FERB's phone apps move, one table for Android (:design MotionTableTest) and iPhone (FerbDesign MotionTests); each side's code (Motion.kt, Motion.swift) must equal it. The owner wants PairIt's motion (kb PHN-620): the numbers are PairIt's (~/Desktop/bluetooth_switch), the lab's where PairIt has none. A spring is its response (seconds for one undamped swing, 2 pi / omega; SwiftUI's spring(response:dampingFraction:), Compose's stiffness (2 pi / response)^2) and its damping ratio.

tab.from: PairIt Android MainActivity.java:185-186, the tab indicator: 650 ms of 1 - e^(-7.5 t)(cos 10 t + 0.75 sin 10 t), the exact step of this spring

press_down.from: PairIt Android GlassUI.java:33-35 and 45-46: the same curve over 220 ms at touch-down

press_up.from: PairIt Android GlassUI.java:45-46: the same curve over 550 ms at release

sheet.from: the glass lab tokens.json motion.panel (spring 0.30 s, bounce 0.08, interruptible); PairIt's iPhone sheets are the system's (ReceiverView.swift:463)

enter.from: PairIt Android MainActivity.java:567 (a panel rises 24 dp and fades in over 220 ms) and PlainSwitch.java:29-30, RelayOutputSelector.java:29 (the same curve)

exit.from: PairIt Android MainActivity.java:58 (the notice fades out over 120 ms); PairIt iPhone RelayStyle.swift:35 (.linear(duration: 0.12))

item.from: PairIt Android MainActivity.java:439-441 (a notice arrives: up 6 dp and in over 180 ms); PairIt iPhone RelayStyle.swift:29 (the same curve)

reduced.from: PairIt iPhone RelayStyle.swift:35: under Reduce Motion a change is a 0.12 s linear fade and nothing moves; Android with animations off: instant (GlassUI.java:27-31, MainActivity.java:184)

press.from: the glass lab tokens.json motion.press and Theme.swift:270-271 (PairIt iPhone RelayStyle.swift:53 sinks to 0.97 too; PairIt Android to 0.95)

tab_overshoot.from: PairIt iPhone ReceiverView.swift:310 and 322: the pill's spring may overshoot the bar's end; the bar's round ends cut it (PairIt Android narrows it instead, MainActivity.java:186: one behaviour on both phones, the one SwiftUI and Compose both draw in place)

scrim.from: the glass lab Mobile.swift Sheet (black at 0.5)

dismiss.from: not from PairIt (its sheets are the system's): a sheet let go past a quarter of its height, or flung down faster than 900 points a second, closes; otherwise it springs back
